hla_service_token.note: Operator-issued, append-only, revocable, fixed-scope bot credential.

hybrid_app_check_or_hla.note: Accepts either Firebase App Check (humans) or hla_ service tokens (verified bots).

workload.active_focus: public discovery and authenticated append-only bot access
